The message then connects public participation to those claimed mining returns, asserting that “there's only one company that allows public to invest with them and that company is beat up Network.” It expressly declares, “so yeah it's a legit company I've proved it here's the proof bit clap net right is the legit company guys join the winning team,” and follows with a direct recruitment instruction: “if you're not yet a member of BITCLAP NETWORK register on there's a link on my description there.” Together, the asserted legitimacy and large earnings figure are used to encourage viewers to register and invest through the description link.
